fichas.title: Scenery workshops and workshop building
fichas.summary: Guidance for the area, arrangement, and equipment of scenery-production workshops. A ground-floor workshop plan identifies painting, assembly, sewing, carpentry, storage, and support spaces. Workshops should be on one level and grouped around an assembly room; workplace and accident-prevention requirements must be considered.

fichas.title: Theatre personnel and dressing rooms
fichas.summary: Personnel accommodation includes artistic staff, stage management, and administration. Modern arrangements place these rooms on one side of the stage, opposite the technical side, potentially across several floors. The illustrated room types include soloist, chorus, orchestra, additional chorus or extras, ballet, technical staff, and make-up rooms.

fichas.title: Sanitary facilities for theatre visitors, performers, and workshop staff
fichas.summary: The page provides fixture-count guidelines for visitors, theatre and opera performers, and workshop staff, with provisions to be separated for women and men. Visitor composition is assumed to be three-fifths women and two-fifths men. Accessible visitor provision includes a wheelchair-accessible WC.
